name: PASSOVER_FATHER
canonical: an archetypal Israelite father of a household on Passover night, a Hebrew man of about forty with weathered olive skin, a dark beard streaked grey, urgent solemn eyes, wearing a simple undyed wool tunic girded at the waist with a leather belt and a head-cloth, sandals on his feet and a staff in hand ready for travel, his hands and forearms marked with lamb's blood from striking the doorposts of his mud-brick dwelling
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
